related_questions.question: What is the ICD-10 code for breast cancer?

text_blocks.snippet: The primary ICD-10-CM code for malignant neoplasm of the breast is C50. This code encompasses various types and locations of breast cancer. More specific codes within the C50 range can be used to denote the exact location and side of the breast cancer.
Here's a breakdown of the relevant codes:

C50.1: Malignant neoplasm of central portion of breast
C50.2: Malignant neoplasm of upper-inner quadrant of breast
C50.3: Malignant neoplasm of lower-inner quadrant of breast
C50.4: Malignant neoplasm of upper-outer quadrant of breast
C50.5: Malignant neoplasm of lower-outer quadrant of breast
C50.6: Malignant neoplasm of overlapping sites of breast
C50.8: Malignant neoplasm of overlapping sites of breast
C50.9: Malignant neoplasm of breast of unspecified site
C50.xx1: Right breast
C50.xx2: Left breast
C50.xx9: Unspecified breast
C79.81: Secondary malignant neoplasm of breast (used for metastasis)

related_questions.question: What is the ICD-10 code for met breast cancer?

text_blocks.snippet: The primary ICD-10-CM code for metastatic breast cancer is C79.81. This code specifically denotes a secondary malignant neoplasm of the breast, indicating that the cancer originated elsewhere and spread to the breast. Additional ICD-10-CM codes may be needed to specify the primary site of the breast cancer and the specific secondary sites where the cancer has metastasized.
Commonly used ICD-10-CM codes for metastatic breast cancer:

list.snippet: C79.81: Secondary malignant neoplasm of the breast.
C50.911: Malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of right female breast.
C50.912: Malignant neoplasm of unspecified site of left female breast.
C79.51: Secondary malignant neoplasm of bone.
C78.01: Secondary malignant neoplasm of the lung.
C78.7: Secondary malignant neoplasm of the liver.
C79.82: Secondary malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified sites.
Z85.3: Personal history of malignant neoplasm of breast.

text_blocks.snippet: Example: If a patient has breast cancer that has metastasized to the bone, the appropriate codes would be C79.51 (secondary malignant neoplasm of bone) and a code for the primary breast cancer, such as C50.911 or C50.912, depending on the affected breast and whether the site is specified.
